scope_amendment.effect: Prospective mutable goal next-action persistence and one write-once batch checkpoint. No new scientific trials, scientific status change or retroactive authority.

effective_handoff.objective: Compose separate observations, source-grounded derivations, explicit alternative explanations and unresolved quantities; rank the next bounded empirical design after the independent reports, with no scientific status change.
effective_handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Which implementation and empirical design most cleanly resolves a named uncertainty while preserving the working baseline?
constraints: Classical algorithms only. No quantum or index-calculus work.

maximum_runs=0: no new nonce/cohort/target generation, candidate panels, old-cohort reanalysis, VM launches, timing benchmarks, or fresh scientific measurements. Symbolic derivation, source inspection and explicitly named prior known-answer software controls are allowed; preserve their actual logs and source.

The earlier cohort describes only its fixed circuits and sampled curves; it neither closes this direction nor establishes mechanism attribution, a general failure theorem, novelty or an asymptotic exponent.

Check internal ledger/knowledge/lead atlas and relevant primary papers before recommendations; cite read depth, provenance and source hashes. Search absence is not a novelty certificate. KB MCP absence is a retrieval limitation.
No coefficient/base tuning, hidden scalar truth or subgroup enumeration inside a candidate API. Separate truth-aided validator work, setup, online, common work, memory and every operation family.

Any future empirical panel requires a separate frozen experiment.protocol/v1, independently reviewed implementation, complete controls, exact source/input/runtime binding, admission and standing-authorization approval before execution. These search handoffs grant none of that execution authority.

Write only assigned prospective paths in an outside delivery package; root alone applies canonical edits and performs Git mutations. Preserve all historical artifacts and statuses. No merge or auto-merge.
Do not call any new scientific experiment approved/runnable: this batch only prepares a detailed specification with outstanding admission/source/freeze obligations.
Write the separately reserved synthesis DEC only as a technical next-action decision, with no support/reject/closure of H/goal and no measured speedup/exponent claim.
Render one readable PDF/diagram covering all three lanes; inspect every page. If any producer/design remains unresolved, preserve that boundary and its exact next test.

Historical lead-atlas verdicts must retain their actual dated method/test boundary: LEAD-TRF discriminant/map-hash equidistribution language and LEAD-EXO-HNP absence-of-measured-bias language are scoped prior records, not present global conclusions about all coordinate predicates/decoders. Cite their exact source and explain which assumption a new lead changes, without editing immutable history.

Prospective scope amendment is effective only after it and the matching queue are committed/pushed before this task is claimed. The original ledger/handoffs card remains byte-identical; this complete effective card is the additive amendment.

Only research_goal.next_action and research_goal.next_action_role may change in goal.yaml; every other key, all scientific statuses and original completion criteria remain byte-identical in parsed value. Point the next action to the new report/next-experiment-spec and named implementation/freeze/admission/counter-replay obligations; classical only.

Create checkpoints/BATCH-07e7ab.yaml exactly once. Record only actual published source/review artifacts, hashes, completed task receipts and current facts. State any final ledger custody as pending, with its task/path and no invented future commit/hash. Never rewrite this checkpoint after its first publication.
No modification of the twelve source artifacts, previous batch checkpoint, old hypothesis or immutable records is authorized.
completion_gate: Every conclusion is scoped as proposed, derived, literature-reported or known-answer software-checked; no fresh empirical claim.
All cited load-bearing sources are actually read, with assumptions and unresolved evidence gaps recorded.
Exact artifacts and machine-readable design are returned with hashes; all errors/counterexamples and failure conditions remain visible.
The goal update changes only next_action/next_action_role; the new checkpoint is a truthful write-once record with actual evidence and explicit pending final custody, not a scientific conclusion.
effective_handoff.return_format: Exact files/hashes, sources read, known-answer logs if any, unresolved obligations and a concrete next test; no scientific status verdict.
